subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: Where e2e-plan emits a harness task or a conventions task, each scenario task shall carry an explicit blocked-by dependency on it, and where the repo already supplies either, scenario tasks shall carry no such dependency; each scenario task shall additionally name the one artifact it exclusively owns, taken from that scenario's normalization (FR-21), and no two scenario tasks in a plan shall name the same artifact.
rationale: harness and conventions before scenarios where either is built, so parallel workers reuse a landed shape rather than each inventing one; exclusive artifact ownership is what stops concurrent scenario tasks colliding, and the executor already builds unblocked-first so only the edges need declaring
fit_criterion: in a produced plan with a harness or conventions task, every scenario task is blocked-by it (native relation); in a plan where the repo supplies both, scenario tasks carry neither edge; every scenario task names exactly one owned artifact and no artifact is named twice; a scenario task with no owned artifact, or two tasks sharing one, is a plan defect
